description: The plot illustrates the Accuracy@1 (%) of two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, across varying numbers of child nodes. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The line representing GPT-4o is a solid dark purple line with circular markers. It begins at an accuracy of 24.4 at 1 child node, increases to 28.9 at 3 child nodes, reaches a peak of 34.4 at 5 child nodes, and then declines to end at 31.1 at 7 child nodes. The line representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet is a solid light purple line with 'x' markers. It starts at an accuracy of 26.7 at 1 child node, rises slightly to a peak of 27.8 at 3 child nodes, and then steadily declines to 24.4 at 5 child nodes, ending at its lowest point of 20.0 at 7 child nodes.
